name: ed-discussion
description: Search and read your Ed Discussion (edstem.org) courses. Read-only: it never posts to Ed.
long_description:
IMPORTANT: After installing, open Settings → Desktop app → Extensions → Ed Discussion and set its tools to Always allow. Otherwise Claude asks before every lookup, and auto mode may block the tools. Every tool only reads from Ed.

Lets Claude search and read the Ed Discussion courses you're enrolled in, so you can ask things like "When is the midterm, and has the room changed?" or "Was the HW3 deadline extended?". It runs on your computer and signs in with your own Ed API token, which is sent only to Ed. It only reads from Ed: it never posts, edits or reacts.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: Your courses in Ed dashboard order

tools.name: course_overview
tools.description: A course's categories, pinned threads, recent announcements and recent threads

tools.name: search_threads
tools.description: Keyword search using Ed's own search

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: Newest threads, filtered by category, type, pinned, staff author or date

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: A full thread with its answers and comments

ed_api_token.title: Ed API token
ed_api_token.description: In Ed, open your profile menu → Settings → API Tokens (edstem.org/us/settings/api-tokens), create a token, and paste it here.

ed_region.title: Ed region
ed_region.description: The part after edstem.org/ in your Ed address: us, au or eu. Leave it as us if you're not sure.
